method: Read page by page from the live R2 file with pdfplumber on 2026-11-24. A range is written only where the page itself names its Part: an Annexure title ('Annexure B8-1', 'ANNEXURE E1-1', 'ANNEXURE E2-1') or the Part's own banner ('Low Density Residential C1'). The tagger uses a range only when the row carries no Part of its own. Pages in no range stay unresolved; reference_pages are the pages that hold no control: the contents list and the general notes.

ranges.evidence: PDF p153 'Annexure B1-1' to p163 'Annexure B1-7'; p164 opens 'Annexure B3-1'.
PDF p164 'Annexure B3-1 Planting List'; p172 opens 'Annexure B5-1'.
PDF p172 'Annexure B5-1', p174 'Annexure B5-2', p177 'Annexure B5-3'; p179 opens 'Annexure B8-1'.
PDF p179 'Annexure B8-1 Charing Cross Conservation Area', p182 'Annexure B8-2 Queens Park Conservation Area'; p186 opens 'PART C RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT'.
PDF p188 'C1 LOW DENSITY RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT'; page 193 carries the banner 'Low Density Residential C1'. C2 opens at p221.
PDF p417 'ANNEXURE E1-1 WIND TUNNEL STUDY'; p419 opens 'ANNEXURE E2-1'.
PDF p419 'ANNEXURE E2-1 DESIGN GUIDELINES' (the Bondi Beachfront Area).

reference_pages.evidence: PDF p11 is part of the plan's contents list ('8.9 Architectural style 94' ... 'B12 SUBDIVISION'): a list of headings, no control.
PDF p187 is headed 'GENERAL NOTES': it says how Part C reads against State legislation and other Parts; it sets no control for a development type.
